phase_transition_mechanism.summary: Phase-1->Phase-2 (mid-round screen wipe) is DATA-DRIVEN by a special map-collision tile the player contacts, NOT a per-round scene table and NOT the TT background bank.
phase_transition_mechanism.collision_probe: player_ground_contact_probe_family_53b34 + horizontal probe 0x53e22-0x54050 read the collision grid at RAM 0x10DE00 via tile lookup 0x53a2e (addr = 0x10DE00 + f(scrollX 0x10AE, scrollY 0x10B0, probe offsets)); tile TYPE = cell & 0x7F.
phase_transition_mechanism.trigger_primary: collision tile type 0x7E under the player -> 0x10E8:=7 (the screen-wipe request)
phase_transition_mechanism.trigger_secondary: per-frame director FUN_00052732 @0x527cc sets 0x10E8:=7 when section-kind A5+0x10A8 in {4,5,6}; A5+0x10A8's writer is a COMPUTED/indirect store with NO static xref (flagged, not assumed) - likely the auto-scroll boundary/vertical-section path
phase_transition_mechanism.consumer: game-state machine @0x3a7d2: on 0x10E8==7 it saves A5+0x1242:=A5+0x13E (checkpoint), sets A5+0x0104:=1, A5+0x0002:=2, A5+0x0004:=2 -> enters transition; @0x3a83a on 0x10E8==16 sets 0x1394:=1, 0x13aa:=9
phase_transition_mechanism.wipe_sequence: A5+0x1394 transition-active (1/0xFF); A5+0x13aa/0x138a sub-state sequencer; A5+0x13B8 0x13E checkpoint; actor array clear (0x2C8 loop @0x3a804); scene reload (0x469e8/0x45dfa/0x3b902); 0x13E restore
phase_transition_mechanism.round_complete_distinct: 0x10E8:=16 @0x51250 (FUN_0005122a) when A5+0x1360==1 (0x13E is a 0x502AC boundary {16,2D,44,5B,72,89}) AND 0x13ac==8 AND 0x13ba==128 = boss-cleared/round-end, separate from the mid-round door wipe
phase_transition_mechanism.round_init_phase: 0x5053a sets 0x10E8:=3 at round start (initial scroll phase)
phase_transition_mechanism.per_round_door_status: BLOCKED (precisely): enumerating 0x7E requires the metatile->collision-property mapping + the per-round metatile-column source feeding collision-grid field @(20). This is a full map-engine decode. A runtime watchpoint on the 0x10DE00 door cell or on 0x53f0c would CORROBORATE positions but is not the static authority the task requires. No per-round door 0x13E is asserted.
phase_transition_mechanism.why_not_TT: a TT background-bank change (R3/R5/R6) is a visual theme change at a scene reload and CORROBORATES a transition there, but is not the phase decoder; R1/R2/R4 cross a gameplay phase within one TT bank, which is exactly why background appearance must not define the phase.

A5_base_unlock.A5: 0x10C000 (arcade work-RAM base) — VERIFIED: 0x10C118(round-intro idx)=A5+0x118(round counter); 0x10C016=A5+0x16(player X); decisively 0x10D0A8(absolute)-0x10C000=0x10A8 => the map-stream byte written at 0x558f8 IS A5+0x10A8. (Genesis port relocates A5 to 0xFF2200; the ARCADE base is 0x10C000.)
A5_base_unlock.consequence_0x10D000: 0x10D000 = A5+0x1000, populated by 0x502cc: 16 map-column stream pointers = base_k + 0x13E*64 (base_0=0x1691C, stride 0x22C0). Advanced +4/column during scroll (0x558c8); rebuilt into 0x10D040(=A5+0x1040) by 0x55904. These 16 streams are VISUAL name-table columns.
A5_base_unlock.consequence_section_kind: A5+0x10A8 (section-kind) = the current map-stream byte from ROM 0x50F6B (indexed by 0x13E via table 0x50EE0). DECODED: values are ONLY {0,1,2}.

section_kind_stream_0x50F6B.meaning: per-0x13E scroll-mode / section marker (drives scroll-column load direction at 0x556a6/0x55738/0x557c4); 0=normal horizontal, 1/2=edge/alternate scroll modes
section_kind_stream_0x50F6B.note: these are the only static per-round section markers; they cluster near round tails and (R5/R6) near the TT-bank changes, but are scroll-mode flags, NOT proven screen-wipe phase boundaries

phase_transition_mechanism.director_456_path_is_DEAD: FUN_00052732 @0x527cc sets 0x10E8:=7 when A5+0x10A8 in {4,5,6}; but A5+0x10A8 = the map-stream byte which is only ever {0,1,2} (see section_kind_stream). Therefore this path is NOT taken in normal play. The 0x7E collision tile is the SOLE live screen-wipe trigger.
phase_transition_mechanism.door_tile_0x7E_source: No code writes 0x7E/126 into the collision grid 0x10DE00 (=A5+0x1E00). Therefore 0x7E is a METATILE-PROPERTY value in the map data. The grid is built by the column builders 0x559b2/0x55a14 which write collision from a per-column record field @(20 + col*2) (a2 = record). The record's collision-field vs visual-field layout and the per-round metatile-column source that feeds @(20) were NOT cleanly isolated statically (the streams' word@+2 is a visual name-table word, not a record pointer; naive scans yield noise).
